scope: Bytebase 3.22.1/FREE; Oracle 26ai 23.26.4.1.0; API/UI và Thin TCPS độc lập, ngày 04/10/2026. DEV/SIT/UAT/mockPROD cùng DB vật lý.

cases.title: Project ownership
cases.criterion: Applications/projects and their database targets have stable identities.
cases.summary: Project và năm target POC có resource name ổn định trong API, UI và các hậu kiểm.

cases.title: Estate inventory
cases.criterion: Register Oracle instances, services, databases/schemas, and environments centrally.
cases.summary: Đăng ký năm project-owned Oracle instance/database/schema. DEV/SIT/UAT/mockPROD có environment. Cùng một DB vật lý.

cases.title: Change identity
cases.criterion: Retain a stable change/release identifier and exact SQL artifact.
cases.summary: Native VERSIONED release giữ version, sheet SHA-256, plan/issue/taskRun và revision liên kết. SQL lấy từ API khớp artifact.

cases.title: Actor records
cases.criterion: Retain requester, approver, executor, database account, and timestamps separately.
cases.summary: Requester, release creator, executor và timestamp tách riêng. Tài khoản Oracle theo schema. Approver thực sự không có vì FREE SKIPPED.

cases.title: Review
cases.criterion: Review the exact SQL intended for the selected Oracle targets.
cases.summary: Review gắn với đúng SQL và target. P04 mới phát hiện ERROR trước issue nhưng execution enforcement vẫn FAIL riêng.

cases.title: Approval scope
cases.criterion: Bind approval to the artifact and target set. Record any later change.
cases.summary: FREE bỏ qua approval template: approvalStatus SKIPPED. Không thể nghiệm thu approval binding.

cases.title: Environment rollout
cases.criterion: Run the same approved change through DEV, SIT, UAT, and PROD in the accepted order.
cases.summary: Native rollout có bốn stage và cùng artifact. API chạy staging trước; staging DONE trước SIT/UAT. Không bắt buộc thứ tự.

cases.title: Manual continuation
cases.criterion: Stop between stages. Resume only through an authorized action.
cases.summary: Sau DEV DONE, SIT NOT_STARTED và chưa có bảng. Requester tiếp tục bị 403; executor tiếp tục tạo đúng bảng/hàng.

cases.title: Failed stage
cases.criterion: Apply the accepted stop policy. Do not continue automatically after an uncertain result.
cases.summary: DEV FAILED với ORA-00942; SIT giữ NOT_STARTED trước thao tác thủ công. Stage sau không tự chạy. Explicit executor vẫn được lên lịch sau lỗi.

cases.title: History and logs
cases.criterion: Display per-target status, execution records, errors, and central audit.
cases.summary: Task/target/log/time và lỗi Oracle đọc được. Audit search/export bị 403 FEATURE_AUDIT_LOG TEAM. Chưa kiểm retention.

cases.title: Estate permissions
cases.criterion: Prevent unauthorized project, target, approval, and execution actions. Verify inherited project access, Participant grants, expiry, and denied Oracle cross-schema access.
cases.summary: Có project role, query/write denial, conditional grant hết hạn, revoke và Oracle cross-schema denial. Approval actions bị FREE chặn.

cases.title: Release readiness
cases.criterion: Identify every missing release, checksum, ledger, locking, and recovery capability.
cases.summary: Đã phân biệt native release/revision, checksum WARNING, target ledger chưa có, dedup/concurrency quan sát được và recovery chưa đủ.

cases.title: CREATE TABLE
cases.criterion: Procedure: Deploy a table with primary key, number, varchar, and timestamp columns. Acceptance: Table exists. One successful target entry and one linked central result exist.
cases.summary: UI chạy CREATE thành công; bảng/PK/type đúng và revision trung tâm liên kết. Không có target migration ledger trong schema.

cases.title: ALTER TABLE
cases.criterion: Procedure: Add a column and a named constraint in a new migration. Acceptance: Both objects exist. Version order and ledger are correct.
cases.summary: Cột STATUS và constraint tồn tại; native version kế tiếp có revision. Chưa có ledger phía Oracle target.

cases.title: INSERT/UPDATE
cases.criterion: Procedure: Insert a row, update its value, and verify the final value. Acceptance: The row changes once. Replay does not increase the row count or value.
cases.summary: Sau INSERT/UPDATE, hàng 1 có amount=150. Replay cùng version skip; hậu kiểm trước/sau replay không đổi.

cases.title: Procedure
cases.criterion: Procedure: Deploy a procedure with internal semicolons and an executable body. Acceptance: Procedure is VALID. Invocation changes the expected row.
cases.summary: Procedure VALID. Invocation chuyển STATUS thành PAID.

cases.title: Function
cases.criterion: Procedure: Deploy a function with a numeric return value. Acceptance: Function is VALID. SELECT from DUAL returns the expected value.
cases.summary: Function VALID. POC_ADD_TAX(100)=110.

cases.title: Package
cases.criterion: Procedure: Deploy a specification and body with initialization code. Acceptance: Both objects are VALID. Package invocation succeeds.
cases.summary: Package/spec/body VALID; invocation đổi NOTE và initialization trả 42.

cases.title: Trigger
cases.criterion: Procedure: Deploy a row trigger that uses :NEW and :OLD. Acceptance: Trigger is VALID. One event produces one expected effect.
cases.summary: Trigger VALID; một UPDATE tạo một audit event 150→200.

cases.title: Anonymous PL/SQL
cases.criterion: Procedure: Execute BEGIN/END and DECLARE/BEGIN/END forms. Acceptance: Each block executes once. Internal semicolons remain intact.
cases.summary: Hai block anonymous chạy; marker 801/802 mỗi loại một hàng.

cases.title: Slash delimiter
cases.criterion: Procedure: Deploy procedural bodies with a slash on a separate line. Acceptance: The parser uses the slash as a client delimiter. Oracle does not receive a bare slash statement.
cases.summary: Body PL/SQL với slash riêng dòng chạy thành công. Không có lỗi bare slash; log có statement ranges.

cases.title: SQLPlus commands
cases.criterion: Procedure: Evaluate PROMPT, SET DEFINE, DEFINE, SPOOL, @, @@, and WHENEVER directives. Acceptance: Required commands work through a supported execution path. Unsupported commands fail clearly before execution.
cases.summary: Bundle SQLPlus FAILED ORA-01008; marker 1001 không có. Chưa kiểm từng directive, thông báo pre-execution hoặc đường native SQLPlus.

cases.title: Invalid compilation
cases.criterion: Procedure: Deploy syntactically accepted PL/SQL with a compilation error. Acceptance: The result reports invalid compilation. ALL_ERRORS identifies the error. The release is not reported as fully successful.
cases.summary: Plan 109/task DONE và UI Deployed; Oracle procedure INVALID, hai USER_ERRORS, gồm PLS-00201.

cases.title: Oracle literal forms
cases.criterion: Procedure: Use q-quoted text, comment markers in strings, quoted identifiers, and nested blocks. Acceptance: The parser preserves the exact body and statement boundaries.
cases.summary: Ba giá trị q-quote, comment marker trong chuỗi và quoted identifier giữ nguyên.

cases.title: Intentional failure
cases.criterion: Procedure: Add a statement that references a missing table. Acceptance: Execution stops according to policy. The central result contains the exact failed migration and Oracle error.
cases.summary: Fixture missing-table FAILED với ORA-00942 và file/version/range trong log. Hàng 1101 không xuất hiện tại thời điểm lỗi.

cases.title: Normal replay
cases.criterion: Procedure: Submit a previously successful versioned migration again. Acceptance: The engine skips the migration. The platform records the replay request without changing target state.
cases.summary: Nộp lại native version đã thành công: task DONE nhưng không chạy lại DML. Hậu kiểm paired trước/sau không đổi.

cases.title: Retry after failure
cases.criterion: Procedure: Retry REC-01 after an approved correction and target inspection. Acceptance: Recovery follows a documented decision. The platform does not repeat committed work without review.
cases.summary: Hậu kiểm 1101=0 rồi tạo version sửa riêng; chạy thành công 1101=1. FREE không có phê duyệt correction thật.

cases.title: Partial DDL
cases.criterion: Procedure: Execute CREATE TABLE, then an invalid ALTER TABLE in one migration. Acceptance: The created table remains visible. The platform reports partial or uncertain state. Automatic replay is blocked.
cases.summary: CREATE được commit; ALTER lỗi ORA-00904 và task FAILED. POC_PARTIAL còn tồn tại. Chưa chứng minh partial-state fencing hoặc cấm mọi replay.

cases.title: Crash after target commit
cases.criterion: Procedure: Stop the process after DDL commits and before target history success is recorded. Acceptance: Restart detects an uncertain result. An operator reconciles objects and history before resuming.
cases.summary: Chưa có crash barrier trước commit và worker restart được kiểm soát.

cases.title: Crash after target history
cases.criterion: Procedure: Stop the worker after the successful target ledger row and before central success recording. Acceptance: Restart reads target success and repairs central state. No SQL replay occurs.
cases.summary: Chưa có commit barrier và phép crash giữa Oracle commit với central revision.

cases.title: Network interruption
cases.criterion: Procedure: Interrupt the connection before execution, during execution, and after commit acknowledgement. Acceptance: The result distinguishes known failure from uncertain outcome. Recovery checks target history and object state.
cases.summary: Chưa cắt network sau commit bằng proxy có checkpoint.

cases.title: Checksum change
cases.criterion: Procedure: Change the content of a successful migration without changing its ID. Acceptance: Validation fails before new SQL executes. An authorized repair cannot be silent.
cases.summary: Đổi SQL giữ native version: check có WARNING Applied file has been modified và hai SHA. Task vẫn DONE/skip. Không đạt yêu cầu validation FAIL.

cases.title: Concurrent runners
cases.criterion: Procedure: Submit two releases for the same target schema simultaneously. Acceptance: Only one migration execution holds the target lock. Both central jobs have accurate results.
cases.summary: Hai native API plan cùng version chạy đồng thời: cả hai DONE, một effect/một SESSION_ID. Chưa quan sát lock holder hoặc hai runner CI độc lập.

cases.title: Duplicate API request
cases.criterion: Procedure: Send the same approved execution request twice. Acceptance: Stable request identity prevents duplicate work. Both API responses link to the same execution decision.
cases.summary: Hai tasks:batchRun cùng task trả 200/200; một taskRun, một effect. Identity dedup đạt tiểu ca; FREE approval SKIPPED nên chưa nghiệm thu approved execution đầy đủ.

cases.title: Central restart
cases.criterion: Procedure: Restart the central service while the worker continues. Acceptance: The platform reconciles the durable job and target state without duplicate execution.
cases.summary: Chưa có controlled multi-replica failover và fencing.

cases.title: Stale lock
cases.criterion: Procedure: Stop a worker while it holds migration or platform locks. Acceptance: Recovery distinguishes a dead worker from a slow worker. An operator can release a proven stale lock.
cases.summary: Chưa restore target từ backup và reconcile revision với trạng thái target.

cases.title: WHO / WHAT / WHERE / WHEN / HOW / RESULT
cases.criterion: A query returns requester, approver, executor, SQL artifact, target, times, trigger, and result.
cases.summary: Join release/plan/issue/taskRun trả requester, creator, executor, hash, target, time, local job, result. Thiếu approver thật trên FREE.

cases.title: Approval binding
cases.criterion: Changing the artifact, target, environment, or release version invalidates the previous approval.
cases.summary: Không có approval template trên FREE để kiểm invalidate khi đổi SQL, target, environment hoặc version.

cases.title: Separation of duties
cases.criterion: An unauthorized requester cannot approve or execute their own production change. Document administrator powers separately.
cases.summary: Requester/CI rollout execute 403. SQL console ban đầu vẫn cho UPDATE vì sqlEditorUser. Đổi requester thành projectDeveloper+sqlEditorReadUser: UPDATE bị permission_denied, SELECT còn hoạt động. FREE approval chưa nghiệm thu.

cases.title: Environment promotion
cases.criterion: Higher environments receive the same immutable artifact after required lower-environment success.
cases.summary: Staging/mockPROD task120 DONE 06:53:11Z; SIT DONE 06:53:27Z, UAT DONE 06:53:56Z. API chấp nhận staging khi lower stages chưa thành công.

cases.title: CI identity
cases.criterion: GitLab and Jenkins triggers retain a named service principal and the initiating job reference.
cases.summary: Named service account tạo plan/issue qua API, giữ principal và local job reference. Chưa chạy job GitLab/Jenkins thật.

cases.title: Backup and restore
cases.criterion: Restored metadata, artifacts, and keys remain readable. Reconciliation detects target changes after the backup.
cases.summary: Chưa có CI runner bị ngắt và resume từ checkpoint có controlled identity.

cases.title: Multiple replicas
cases.criterion: Concurrent API servers cannot dispatch duplicate target execution.
cases.summary: Chưa có runner reassignment/failover với fencing.

cases.title: Secret handling
cases.criterion: Logs and stored results contain no database passwords or secret-manager credentials.
cases.summary: Known-secret scan trên task evidence và asset công bố không thấy bí mật. Không thể kiểm audit payload/export đầy đủ trên FREE.

cases.title: Audit export
cases.criterion: Audit export preserves actor, artifact hash, target, time, trigger, and result after log rotation.
cases.summary: Audit search/export trả 403 TEAM feature. UI ghi Pro. Chưa có export hoặc rotation proof; không tự bật trial.
